messages:
Maya: Hey runtime + SDK teams — docs PR blocked. Need a quick, authoritative confirmation on config precedence and streaming cancel behavior before the merge window tomorrow. The migration guide example uses global defaults + route overrides + canary, but SDK snippet reviewers reported contradictory runtime results regarding prefetch_ttl and streaming cancellation. Can someone confirm actual merge order and SDK expectations?

Devin: Short answer: runtime precedence is global -> route -> canary -> request. But there9s an important historical edge-case: omitted keys in canary used to fallback to global in runtimes older than the 2024-09-18 fix. Newer runtimes skip omitted canary keys so the route value applies. Which cluster did you test on?

Maya: Test was on staging (stg-us-west-2). Example YAML we used: ```
defaults:
  prefetch_ttl: 30
routes:
  - name: summary
    prefetch_ttl: 60
canary:
  - name: summary
    # no prefetch_ttl set here
```
And JS SDK snippet: ```
const res = await client.generate({route: 'summary', prefetch_ttl: undefined})
const stream = res.stream()
// cancel after first chunk
stream.cancel()
```
Reviewers saw the runtime return 30s TTL for canary requests and also reported that stream.cancel() didn't halt the background prefetch on their environment.

Alex: SDK note: stream.cancel() semantics changed in SDK v0.7. Older SDK versions didn't reliably propagate cancellation to the prefetch pipeline. Two options: update the docs snippet to show an explicit AbortController, or state the minimum SDK version required for the cancel behavior shown. Example safe snippet: ```
const ac = new AbortController();
const res = await client.generate({route: 'summary'});
const stream = res.stream({signal: ac.signal});
setTimeout(() => ac.abort(), 50);
```
This makes the cancellation explicit across versions.

Maya: Good — that clears the SDK side. For the runtime wording, would the phrasing "Runtime versions before 2024-09-18 apply omitted canary fields as global defaults. Upgrading the runtime ensures omitted canary fields inherit from the route-level defaults as shown above." be accurate/acceptable for docs?

Devin: LGTM. Add a one-line troubleshooting command: "If you see unexpected TTL behavior on staging, verify runtime version: `redwood-runtime --version` >= 2024.09.18." That helps infra folks confirm the patch level.

Sam: Process note: docs reviewers are queued for tomorrow's merge window (14:00 PT). We need a runtime and SDK sign-off in thread so Priya can merge after CI passes. @Maya will update the PR with the AbortController snippet and the runtime note — can someone take final sign-off?

CI Bot: docs-preview: linkcheck failed for http://old-docs.example.com/migrate (404) — retry scheduled.

Devin: Also callout: clusters that haven't received the 2024-09-18 runtime roll will show the old fallback behavior (global applied) which explains the 30s observed. Docs should be explicit about the minimum runtime version.

Priya: Quick review of the PR updates: wording looks concise. Replace "cluster patched" with "runtime upgraded" to keep user-facing language simple. The AbortController example is clear. From docs POV: LGTM pending CI green and runtime/SDK one-liners.

Maya: Updated PR: added runtime upgrade note, replaced SDK snippet with AbortController, added troubleshooting checkbox to confirm runtime version on staging. Pinging reviewers for one-line LGTM so I can merge during the window.

Sam: @Devin and @Alex please drop a one-line LGTM if you're ok. Also file a tiny follow-up task to add a short entry to the upgrade notes page about the 2024-09-18 semantics change so customers aren't surprised.

Devin: LGTM. Also: add the verification command in the troubleshooting section as suggested.

Alex: LGTM for SDK snippet and version note. I will follow up to add an SDK changelog blurb about streaming cancellation semantics in v0.7.

CI Bot: docs-preview: retry succeeded, linkcheck green.

Maya: Thanks everyone — PR updated and queued for merge in tomorrow's window. If anyone sees anything else I'll address it before 14:00 PT. :thumbsup:
